title: HSK1 Gate 16 · Liao Dynasty
explanationEn: Gate 16: Liao Dynasty. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第16关：辽国。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 中国北边有很大的草地。那里没有山，只有天和草。很久以前，那里住着一些人。他们叫契丹人。
passageEn: In the north of China there is a great grassland. There are no mountains there, only sky and grass. Long ago some people lived there. They were called the Khitan.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: In the north of China there is a great grassland.
comprehension.answer: 中国北边有很大的草地。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answerEn: Long ago some people lived there.
comprehension.answer: 很久以前，那里住着一些人。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 北 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“北”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 北 (běi) means "north" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “北”（běi）的意思是“north”，就在上面的短文里。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 边 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“边”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 边 (biān) means "side; edge" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “边”（biān）的意思是“side; edge”，就在上面的短文里。

check.zh: 中国北边有很大的草地。

options.text: The water was very big; many people had no home.
In the north of China there is a great grassland.
Long ago, the waters of China were very high.

check.explanationEn: "中国北边有很大的草地。" means "In the north of China there is a great grassland.".
check.explanation: “中国北边有很大的草地。”的意思是“In the north of China there is a great grassland.”。

speakingPromptEn: Tell a grown-up about Liao Dynasty in two or three short Chinese sentences. Use words from the list above.
speakingPrompt: 用上面的词，跟家里的大人说两三句中文，说一说辽国。
